historical_commentary.text: Office 2003's XML file formats and this era's raw-XML/SOAP integration techniques have since been superseded first by the Office Open XML (.docx/.xlsx) formats introduced in Office 2007, and more broadly by REST/JSON-based integration approaches, so the specific mechanisms hinted at here are obsolete. The broader theme — that 4D can interoperate with desktop productivity suites via structured data exchange — remains conceptually relevant, just via very different modern tooling.
related_updates: Microsoft Office moved to the Office Open XML formats (.docx/.xlsx/.pptx) starting with Office 2007, superseding the Office 2003 XML formats referenced here
SOAP-based Web Services integration has broadly given way to REST/JSON APIs in modern application integration, including in current 4D
